questions.question: How did Job describe man's life?
options: Long and secure, free from harm
Few of days and full of trouble
questions.answer: Few of days and full of trouble

questions.question: What hope did Job note about a tree compared to man?
options: Man, much like a tree, only grows stronger with each passing year
A tree dies forever, but man is raised again at the very last day
A cut tree may sprout again, but man lies down and does not rise
Both the tree and man alike wither and return to the dust
questions.answer: A cut tree may sprout again, but man lies down and does not rise

questions.question: Job compared man to a flower that comes up and withers.
